showcase.title: AI-Assisted Knowledge & Workflow Copilot Dashboard
showcase.description: A four-page React knowledge and operations dashboard with a daily Copilot briefing, knowledge-corpus metrics, weekly workflow planning, and business analytics. Syncfusion Grid, Scheduler, Chart, Card, ListView, TextBox, and Button components support the experience. A deterministic local sample AI provider answers prompts using bundled JSON fixtures; the application does not connect to external AI services or business systems.

components.component: Displays knowledge article records and regional analytics drilldown data with sortable and searchable columns.
Presents the sample operational workflow schedule in a weekly planning view.
Visualizes knowledge confidence and readership alongside revenue trends, regional share, and deal-size comparisons.
Groups KPI summaries, daily briefing content, SLA exposure, assistant panels, and analytics.
Renders the Copilot Hub activity stream and the workflow action queue.
Purpose-built local assistant panels return deterministic responses grounded in bundled JSON fixtures; no external model or AI service is called.
